_comment: Jurisdiction spec for the refresh.py orchestrator. See _schema.json.
name: United States

acquire._comment: Wraps src/01_scrape_revision_dates.R + latest_revision.R + src/02_download_hts.R. The revision registry config/revision_dates.csv is OWNED by the R scrape — the orchestrator never writes it.

publish._comment_keep: Latest + previous two, per operator decision 2026-08-27. Pruning happens only at swap time, so history is never trimmed retroactively.

envvars._comment: Deliberately US-only across the fleet: other jurisdictions resolve their revision from Supabase (countryConfig.ts), which needs no deploy. These VITE_ vars remain only for the US Explorer/agent boot path.
